instruction: Locate and open the travel deals and offers page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United homepage to the deals/offers page. Evaluator verifies URL contains 'united.com' and one of the keywords: deals, offers, or promotions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: navigation to United Airlines deals/offers page
Getter 'active_tab_info' successfully extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly applies regex patterns to verify URL
Pattern 2 ('deals|offers|promotions') correctly matches common URL patterns for deals pages
Data flow is correct: URL extraction -> regex pattern matching -> score return
Logic correctly requires ALL patterns to match (both domain AND deals keyword)
State is accessible without special postconfig (reads from accessibility tree)
Expected values are semantically correct for the task requirements
